messages.author: 0886a511cd5fa3ed
messages.subject: R crashes mapping predictions
parts:
Hi,
I was wondering if anyone has run into a problem with R crashing (R gui front end has stopped working) while mapping model predictions (OccWetland.1<-predict(fm1BestColext, type="psi", newdata=Wetland.1)).  I am following the Modeling and Mapping Species Distributions vignette from October 2012.  
I have a rather large raster consisting of three layers that I stacked. 
class       : RasterStack 
dimensions  : 3647, 3426, 12494622, 3  (nrow, ncol, ncell, nlayers)
resolution  : 150, 150  (x, y)
extent      : -1892138, -1378238, 1106493, 1653543  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
coord. ref. : +proj=aea +lat_1=29.5 +lat_2=45.5 +lat_0=23 +lon_0=-96 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=GRS80 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs 
names       :            P1,            EM,             C 
min values  : -1.844203e+00, -8.323580e+09, -7.763713e-01 
max values  :      1.779348,      3.074031,      3.443460 

Because the raster is so large, I have been breaking the raster down into chunks to process it. I can sometimes get results when I use 1000 rows of data, but other times when I run another chunk of 1000 rows or less, R gui front end stops working and R crashes.  Does anyone know what could be causing this and how to fix it?  R  and all of my packages are up-to-date.  I don't think it is a memory issues as the program is only using 50% of the memory when I encounter these problems.  I am running 64-bit R on a Windows 7 professional edition. 

Is there a way to subset a Raster stack other than first subsetting the original data file and then building a new raster stack for each subset of data? 

landscape <- read.csv(file="YCR_Range_NWI_components.csv")
head(landscape)
          x       y EM P1 C
1 -1454663 1194018  0  0 0
2 -1454513 1194018  0  0 0
3 -1454363 1194018  0  0 0
4 -1454213 1194018  0  0 0
5 -1454063 1194018  0  0 0
6 -1454813 1194168  0  0 0

landscape.1<-landscape[1:1000,]

P1.1<-rasterFromXYZ(landscape.1[,c("x","y","P1")],
                    crs="+proj=aea +lat_1=29.5 +lat_2=45.5 +lat_0=23 +lon_0=-96 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=GRS80 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs")
EM.1<-rasterFromXYZ(landscape.1[,c("x","y","EM")],
                    crs="+proj=aea +lat_1=29.5 +lat_2=45.5 +lat_0=23 +lon_0=-96 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=GRS80 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs")
C.1<-rasterFromXYZ(landscape.1[,c("x","y","C")],
                     crs="+proj=aea +lat_1=29.5 +lat_2=45.5 +lat_0=23 +lon_0=-96 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=GRS80 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs")


Thanks!!

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] R crashes mapping predictions
parts:
Hi Kathi,

If you are using the new version of unmarked, then I think it must be a memory issue. I guess you will need to use smaller chunks of data. At some point, I will try to improve the way large rasters are handled.

Richard
